description: Lists or switches the user's Gamealia developer accounts (their own and studios they joined). API keys are bound to one account and every other tool acts on the active one, so when the user has several, confirm the right one before creating or publishing games. action "list" (read-only) returns each account (id, name, individual/business, role: owner, admin, developer or finance), which is active and pending invites. action "switch" makes another account active with a stored key, or starts a device login bound to it (show the URL and code, then call gamealia_login with wait:true).

account.description: Required for switch: the account id or display name, as shown by action list

action.description: list: show the accounts (changes nothing); switch: make the given account active

name: gamealia_accounts
title: Developer accounts
